# Love and Paris

> > A comprehensive Paris travel guide covering neighborhoods, hotels, viewpoints, seasonal events, and practical travel tips for exploring the City of Light.

Love and Paris helps travelers discover the best of Paris through curated guides on where to stay (from boutique hotels to budget hostels), what to see (iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, Montmartre, and Sacré-Coeur), and how to navigate the city like a local. The site covers everything from arrondissement guides and accommodation recommendations to seasonal activities and avoiding common tourist scams.

## Key Topics

- Paris neighborhoods and arrondissements
- Eiffel Tower views and viewpoints
- Montmartre and Sacré-Coeur
- Left Bank and Saint Germain
- Louvre and Tuileries Gardens
- Boutique hotels and accommodation
- Budget-friendly travel tips
- Paris Marais district
- Latin Quarter
- Notre Dame and Seine River
- Champs-Élysées
- Airport transfers (CDG, Orly, Beauvais)
- Paris travel safety and scams
- Seasonal events and attractions
- Free attractions and activities

## Essential Paris Travel Guides

- [8 Great Areas to Stay in While Visiting Paris](https://loveandparis.co/great-areas-to-stay-paris): Paris neighborhood guide covering Left Bank, Right Bank & arrondissements
- [How to Get from your Paris Airport to the City Centre](https://loveandparis.co/how-to-get-from-airport-to-paris): Airport transfer guide for CDG, Orly & Beauvais to Paris city centre
- [9 Biggest Scams in Paris & How to Avoid Them](https://loveandparis.co/avoid-biggest-scams-paris): Paris travel safety guide covering taxi scams, pickpockets & tourist traps

## Paris Hotels and Accommodation

- [8 Great Paris Hotels For Solo Travelers](https://loveandparis.co/hotels-for-solo-travelers-paris): Solo traveler hotel guide featuring Le Pigalle, Montmartre & Left Bank
- [8 Best Paris Hotels For Families](https://loveandparis.co/family-hotels-paris): Family-friendly hotels & aparthotels near Louvre and Tuileries Gardens
- [Best Hotels in Paris for Long Stays](https://loveandparis.co/best-long-stay-hotels-paris): Extended stay hotels & apart-hotels like Le Matissia near Gare du Nord
- [8 Cool Hotels In Saint-Germain Paris To Book A Room In](https://loveandparis.co/saint-germain-hotels-paris): Saint-Germain Left Bank hotel guide for 6th & 7th arrondissements
- [The Best Hotels to Book in Paris's Trendy Marais District](https://loveandparis.co/hotels-marais-paris): Marais boutique hotels including Le Grand Mazarin with Boubalé restaurant
- [8 Top Paris Hotels With Amazing Views you MUST book](https://loveandparis.co/paris-hotels-with-amazing-views): Hotels with Eiffel Tower, Notre Dame & Sacré-Coeur views like Terrass
- [Top Hostels in Paris for Budget Travellers](https://loveandparis.co/hostels-paris): Budget hostel recommendations including MIJE in Marais near Louvre

## Paris Viewpoints and Attractions

- [10 Incredible Viewpoints in Paris (that aren't the Eiffel Tower)](https://loveandparis.co/best-viewpoints-paris): Alternative panoramic viewpoints: Sacré-Coeur, Arc de Triomphe & more
- [Best spots in Paris to watch the sunset (whatever your budget)](https://loveandparis.co/best-sunset-spots-paris): Budget-friendly sunset viewpoints along Seine River & Pont des Arts
- [8 Cool (and Free) Places to Warm up while exploring Paris](https://loveandparis.co/free-places-to-warm-up-paris): Free indoor winter spots: Latin Quarter churches, bookshops & cafés

## Seasonal Events and Activities

- [8 Cool Things to Do in Paris on New Year's Eve](https://loveandparis.co/things-to-do-new-years-eve-paris): New Year's Eve guide: Seine cruises, Champs-Élysées fireworks & reveillon
- [Where to See the Best Christmas Lights in Paris](https://loveandparis.co/best-christmas-lights-paris): Christmas lights guide: Place Vendôme, Opéra District & Tuileries Gardens
- [Top Things to Do in Paris in March](https://loveandparis.co/things-to-do-paris-march): March spring guide: cherry blossoms at Palais-Royal & Jardin des Plantes
- [What to Do in Paris on Bastille Day](https://loveandparis.co/what-to-do-bastille-day-paris): July 14th Bastille Day events: Champs-Élysées parade & celebrations
